# Seasons

> Four seasonal portfolio templates built with Nuxt 3 and Nuxt UI, by Eco Development Studios.

Seasons is a showcase of Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter portfolio designs for freelancers and creative professionals.

## Public pages

- [Seasons](https://seasons.ecostudios.dev/): template selector.
- [Spring](https://seasons.ecostudios.dev/seasons/spring): portfolio preview.
- [Summer](https://seasons.ecostudios.dev/seasons/summer): portfolio preview.
- [Autumn](https://seasons.ecostudios.dev/seasons/autumn): portfolio preview.
- [Winter](https://seasons.ecostudios.dev/seasons/winter): portfolio preview.
- [Sitemap](https://seasons.ecostudios.dev/sitemap.xml): public page list.
- [Eco Development Studios](https://www.ecostudios.dev/): publisher.
